unresolved.what: Northern Province after the 2017 reform (Bombali, Koinadugu, Falaba, Tonkolili)
unresolved.why: The 2017 reform moved Kambia and Port Loko districts to the new North West Province and formed Karene District from five whole Bombali chiefdoms (Libeisaygahun, Sanda Loko, Sanda Tendaren, Sella Limba, Tambakha), three whole Port Loko chiefdoms (Buya Romende, Dibia, Sanda Magbolontor) and the Gbanti half of Bombali's Gbanti Kamaranka chiefdom, whose Kamaranka half stayed in Bombali (Northern). The Northern/North West line therefore runs through a pre-2017 chiefdom, so it cannot be drawn with the 2016 chiefdom atoms (geoBoundaries SLE ADM3) either, let alone the NE Northern atom. The effective day in 2017 is also not established (August 2017 per sierra-leone.org; ratified December 2017 per Wikipedia).
